component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.guideBackground = m.top.findNode("guideBackground") m.tvGuide = m.top.findNode("tvGuide") m.liveTVGuide = m.top.findNode("liveTVGuide") m.errorStaticVideo = m.top.findNode("errorStaticVideo") m.playlistGuide = m.top.findNode("playlistGuide") m.videoComponent = m.top.findNode("videoComponent") m.sideMenu = m.top.findNode("sideMenu") m.settingsView = m.top.findNode("settingsView") m.capabilityValidator = m.top.findNode("capabilityValidator") m.catalogTask = m.top.findNode("catalogTask") m.liveGuideTask = m.top.findNode("liveGuideTask") m.playlistTask = m.top.findNode("playlistTask") m.playlistLoadWatchdog = m.top.findNode("playlistLoadWatchdog")
m.loadingDialog = invalid m.errorDialog = invalid m.menuReturnTarget = "tvGuide" m.activeGuide = "onDemand" m.errorReturnTarget = ""
m.tvGuide.observeField("channelSelected", "onChannelSelected") m.tvGuide.observeField("channelBrowseRequested", "onChannelBrowseRequested") m.tvGuide.observeField("menuRequested", "onTvGuideMenuRequested") m.liveTVGuide.observeField("channelSelected", "onLiveChannelSelected") m.liveTVGuide.observeField("menuRequested", "onLiveGuideMenuRequested") m.playlistGuide.observeField("itemSelected", "onPlaylistItemSelected") m.playlistGuide.observeField("closeRequested", "onPlaylistGuideClosed") m.playlistGuide.observeField("menuRequested", "onPlaylistGuideMenuRequested") m.sideMenu.observeField("closeRequested", "onSideMenuClosed") m.sideMenu.observeField("settingsRequested", "onSettingsRequested") m.sideMenu.observeField("viewRequested", "onViewRequested") m.settingsView.observeField("closeRequested", "onSettingsViewClosed") m.settingsView.observeField("settingChanged", "onSettingChanged") m.capabilityValidator.observeField("complete", "onCapabilitiesValidated") m.catalogTask.observeField("catalog", "onCatalogLoaded") m.catalogTask.observeField("errorMessage", "onCatalogError") m.liveGuideTask.observeField("guide", "onLiveGuideLoaded") m.liveGuideTask.observeField("errorMessage", "onLiveGuideError") m.liveTVGuide.observeField("windowRequested", "onLiveGuideWindowRequested") m.playlistTask.observeField("playlist", "onPlaylistLoaded") m.playlistTask.observeField("errorMessage", "onPlaylistError") m.playlistLoadWatchdog.observeField("fire", "onPlaylistLoadTimeout") m.videoComponent.observeField("playbackEnded", "onPlaybackEnded")
appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") m.serverUrl = resolveServerUrl(appInfo.getValue("channel_catalog_url"))
m.defaultChannel = "" defaultChannelValue = appInfo.getValue("default_channel") if defaultChannelValue <> invalid then m.defaultChannel = defaultChannelValue.trim() m.defaultChannelBackDestination = "home" backDestinationValue = appInfo.getValue("default_channel_back_destination") if backDestinationValue <> invalid and LCase(backDestinationValue.trim()) = "guide" m.defaultChannelBackDestination = "guide" end if m.liveGuideBackDestination = "onDemand" liveGuideBackValue = appInfo.getValue("live_guide_back_destination") if liveGuideBackValue <> invalid normalizedDestination = LCase(liveGuideBackValue.trim()) if normalizedDestination = "menu" or normalizedDestination = "home" m.liveGuideBackDestination = normalizedDestination end if end if m.defaultChannelPlayback = false m.liveGuideTaskStarted = false m.liveGuideReloadRequestId = 0 catalogTimeout = 0 catalogTimeoutValue = appInfo.getValue("channel_catalog_timeout_seconds") if catalogTimeoutValue <> invalid and catalogTimeoutValue <> "" catalogTimeout = catalogTimeoutValue.toInt() end if if catalogTimeout <= 0 then catalogTimeout = 10 m.catalogTask.timeoutSeconds = catalogTimeout startupVideoUrl = appInfo.getValue("startup_video_url") if startupVideoUrl <> invalid then m.capabilityValidator.startupVideoUrl = startupVideoUrl.trim() startupVideoMode = appInfo.getValue("startup_video_mode") if startupVideoMode <> invalid then m.capabilityValidator.startupVideoMode = startupVideoMode.trim() m.capabilityValidator.validationRequested = true end sub
sub onCapabilitiesValidated() if not m.capabilityValidator.complete then return showLoading("Loading TV guide...") m.catalogTask.uri = m.serverUrl loadLiveGuide() 'm.catalogTask.control = "run" end sub
sub onCatalogLoaded(event as object) catalog = event.getData() if catalog = invalid then return closeLoading() m.tvGuide.content = catalog m.activeGuide = "onDemand" m.errorReturnTarget = "" showGuide("onDemand") defaultChannelIndex = findDefaultChannel(catalog, m.defaultChannel) if defaultChannelIndex >= 0 m.defaultChannelPlayback = true loadChannel(defaultChannelIndex, false) return end if focusTvGuide() end sub
function findDefaultChannel(catalog as object, configuredChannel as string) as integer if catalog = invalid or configuredChannel = "" then return -1 selector = normalizedChannelSelector(configuredChannel) for index = 0 to catalog.getChildCount() - 1 channel = catalog.getChild(index) if channel <> invalid if normalizedChannelSelector(channel.title) = selector then return index if normalizedChannelSelector(channel.url) = selector then return index if normalizedChannelSelector(channel.playlistUrl) = selector then return index if normalizedChannelSelector(channelPath(channel.url)) = selector then return index end if end for return -1 end function
function normalizedChannelSelector(value as string) as string normalized = value.trim() transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") normalized = transfer.unescape(normalized) while normalized.len() > 0 and normalized.right(1) = "/" normalized = normalized.left(normalized.len() - 1) end while if instr(1, normalized, "://") = 0 while normalized.len() > 0 and normalized.left(1) = "/" normalized = normalized.mid(1) end while end if return LCase(normalized) end function
function channelPath(value as string) as string normalized = value queryAt = instr(1, normalized, "?") if queryAt > 0 then normalized = normalized.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, normalized, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then normalized = normalized.left(fragmentAt - 1) while normalized.len() > 0 and normalized.right(1) = "/" normalized = normalized.left(normalized.len() - 1) end while slashAt = 0 for index = normalized.len() to 1 step -1 if normalized.mid(index - 1, 1) = "/" slashAt = index exit for end if end for if slashAt > 0 then return normalized.mid(slashAt) return normalized end function
sub onCatalogError(event as object) message = event.getData() if message <> "" then showApiError(message) end sub
sub onLiveGuideLoaded(event as object) guide = event.getData() if guide = invalid then return m.liveTVGuide.content = guide if guide.reset <> true then return closeLoading() m.activeGuide = "liveTV" m.errorReturnTarget = "" showGuide("liveTV") focusLiveGuide() end sub
sub onLiveGuideError(event as object) message = event.getData() if message <> "" then showApiError(message) end sub
sub onLiveGuideWindowRequested(event as object) request = event.getData() if type(request) = "roAssociativeArray" then m.liveGuideTask.windowRequest = request end sub
sub onChannelSelected(event as object) m.defaultChannelPlayback = false loadChannel(event.getData(), false) end sub
sub onChannelBrowseRequested(event as object) m.defaultChannelPlayback = false loadChannel(event.getData(), true) end sub
sub onLiveChannelSelected(event as object) m.errorReturnTarget = "" if m.liveTVGuide.content = invalid then return index = event.getData() windowIndex = index - m.liveTVGuide.content.windowChannelStart if windowIndex < 0 or windowIndex >= m.liveTVGuide.content.getChildCount() then return channel = m.liveTVGuide.content.getChild(windowIndex) if channel = invalid or channel.liveUrl = "" showError("The selected Live TV channel has no playback URL.") return end if
playlist = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item = playlist.createChild("ContentNode") item.addFields({ resolveUrl: channel.liveUrl, metadataLength: -1 }) item.title = channel.title item.description = channel.description item.HDPosterUrl = channel.HDPosterUrl m.selectedChannel = channel m.defaultChannelPlayback = false startPlayback(playlist, 0, false, "liveTVGuide") end sub
sub loadChannel(index as integer, browseMode as boolean) if m.tvGuide.content = invalid then return channel = m.tvGuide.content.getChild(index) if channel = invalid then return
status = LCase(channel.channelStatus) if status = "offline" or status = "inactive" or status = "disabled" showError(channel.title + " is currently " + channel.channelStatus + ".") return end if
m.selectedChannel = channel m.loadingBrowseMode = browseMode showLoading("Loading " + channel.title + "...") m.playlistTask.control = "stop" m.playlistTask.uri = channel.playlistUrl m.playlistTask.playlistType = channel.playlistType m.playlistTask.resolverUri = channel.url m.playlistTask.browseMode = browseMode m.playlistTask.control = "run" m.playlistLoadWatchdog.control = "start" end sub
sub onPlaylistLoaded(event as object) playlist = event.getData() if playlist = invalid or m.selectedChannel = invalid then return m.playlistLoadWatchdog.control = "stop" closeLoading() m.selectedChannel.totalNumOfVideos = playlist.getChildCount() totalSeconds = playlistDuration(playlist) if totalSeconds >= 0 m.selectedChannel.totalPlaylistInMinutes = totalSeconds / 60.0 else m.selectedChannel.totalPlaylistInMinutes = 0 end if if m.loadingBrowseMode m.channelPlaylist = playlist m.playlistGuide.channelTitle = m.selectedChannel.title m.playlistGuide.content = playlist showPlaylistGuide() focusPlaylistGuide() return end if
m.tvGuide.visible = false if m.selectedChannel.playlistType = "server-random" startPlayback(playlist, 0, false, "tvGuide") else startPlayback(playlist, m.selectedChannel.currentIndex, false, "tvGuide") end if end sub
function playlistDuration(playlist as object) as integer total = 0 for index = 0 to playlist.getChildCount() - 1 item = playlist.getChild(index) if item = invalid or item.metadataLength < 0 then return -1 total += item.metadataLength end for return total end function
sub onPlaylistItemSelected(event as object) if m.channelPlaylist = invalid then return startPlayback(m.channelPlaylist, event.getData(), true, "playlistGuide") end sub
sub startPlayback(playlist as object, startIndex as integer, singleItem as boolean, returnTarget as string) m.playbackReturnTarget = returnTarget m.guideBackground.active = false m.tvGuide.visible = false m.liveTVGuide.visible = false m.playlistGuide.visible = false m.videoComponent.visible = true m.videoComponent.startIndex = startIndex m.videoComponent.singleItem = singleItem m.videoComponent.loopPlaylist = (returnTarget = "liveTVGuide") m.videoComponent.playbackMode = "onDemand" m.videoComponent.livePlaylistCount = 0 if returnTarget = "liveTVGuide" m.videoComponent.playbackMode = "live" if m.selectedChannel <> invalid then m.videoComponent.livePlaylistCount = livePlaylistSize(m.selectedChannel) else if not singleItem and m.selectedChannel <> invalid and m.selectedChannel.playlistType = "server-random" m.videoComponent.playbackMode = "shuffle" end if if returnTarget = "liveTVGuide" m.videoComponent.exitDestinationLabel = "Live TV" else if m.defaultChannelPlayback and m.defaultChannelBackDestination = "home" m.videoComponent.exitDestinationLabel = "Roku Home" else m.videoComponent.exitDestinationLabel = "TV Guide" end if m.videoComponent.channelTitle = m.selectedChannel.title m.videoComponent.playlist = playlist m.videoComponent.playbackRequested = true m.videoComponent.setFocus(true) end sub
function livePlaylistSize(channel as object) as integer if channel.playlistSize <> invalid and channel.playlistSize > 0 then return channel.playlistSize highestIndex = -1 for index = 0 to channel.getChildCount() - 1 program = channel.getChild(index) if program <> invalid and program.programIndex > highestIndex then highestIndex = program.programIndex end for return highestIndex + 1 end function
sub onPlaylistError(event as object) message = event.getData() if message <> "" m.playlistLoadWatchdog.control = "stop" showApiError(message) end if end sub
sub onPlaylistLoadTimeout() m.playlistTask.control = "stop" showApiError("The playlist could not be loaded.") end sub
sub onPlaybackEnded() m.videoComponent.visible = false if m.defaultChannelPlayback and m.defaultChannelBackDestination = "home" and m.videoComponent.exitReason = "user" m.top.closeRequested = true return end if m.defaultChannelPlayback = false if m.playbackReturnTarget = "liveTVGuide" showGuide("liveTV") focusLiveGuide() else if m.playbackReturnTarget = "playlistGuide" and m.channelPlaylist <> invalid showPlaylistGuide() focusPlaylistGuide() else showGuide("onDemand") focusTvGuide() end if end sub
sub onPlaylistGuideClosed() showGuide("onDemand") focusTvGuide() end sub
sub showLoading(title as string) m.loadingDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "ProgressDialog") m.loadingDialog.title = title m.top.dialog = m.loadingDialog end sub
sub closeLoading() if m.loadingDialog <> invalid then m.loadingDialog.close = true m.loadingDialog = invalid end sub
sub showError(message as string) m.loadingDialog = invalid m.errorDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.errorDialog.title = "TV Guide Error" m.errorDialog.buttons = [ "OK" ] m.errorDialog.message = message m.errorDialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onErrorButtonSelected") m.errorDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onErrorClosed") m.top.dialog = m.errorDialog end sub
sub showApiError(message as string) closeLoading() staticContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") staticContent.url = "pkg:/tvstatic2p.mp4" staticContent.title = "TV static" staticContent.streamFormat = "mp4"
m.guideBackground.active = false m.tvGuide.visible = false m.liveTVGuide.visible = false m.playlistGuide.visible = false m.videoComponent.visible = false m.errorStaticVideo.visible = true m.errorStaticVideo.content = staticContent m.errorStaticVideo.control = "play" showError(message) end sub
sub onErrorButtonSelected() if m.errorDialog <> invalid then m.errorDialog.close = true end sub
sub onErrorClosed() m.errorDialog = invalid if m.errorStaticVideo.visible m.errorStaticVideo.control = "stop" m.errorStaticVideo.visible = false end if if m.videoComponent.visible m.videoComponent.setFocus(true) else if m.errorReturnTarget = "settings" m.errorReturnTarget = "" m.settingsView.serverUrl = m.serverUrl m.settingsView.visible = true m.settingsView.focusRequested = true else showGuide(m.activeGuide) if m.activeGuide = "liveTV" focusLiveGuide() else focusTvGuide() end if end if end sub
sub focusTvGuide() m.tvGuide.setFocus(true) m.tvGuide.focusRequested = true end sub
sub focusPlaylistGuide() m.playlistGuide.setFocus(true) m.playlistGuide.focusRequested = true end sub
sub focusLiveGuide() m.liveTVGuide.setFocus(true) m.liveTVGuide.focusRequested = true end sub
sub showGuide(guideName as string) showGuideBackground(guideName) m.tvGuide.visible = (guideName = "onDemand") m.liveTVGuide.visible = (guideName = "liveTV") m.playlistGuide.visible = false m.settingsView.visible = false end sub
sub showPlaylistGuide() showGuideBackground("onDemand") m.tvGuide.visible = false m.liveTVGuide.visible = false m.playlistGuide.visible = true m.settingsView.visible = false end sub
sub showGuideBackground(guideName as string) videoKey = "ondemand_background_video" imageKey = "ondemand_background_image" if guideName = "liveTV" videoKey = "live_guide_background_video" imageKey = "live_guide_background_image" end if
if m.guideBackground.videoKey <> videoKey or m.guideBackground.imageKey <> imageKey m.guideBackground.active = false m.guideBackground.videoKey = videoKey m.guideBackground.imageKey = imageKey end if setGuideBackgroundActive(true) end sub
sub setGuideBackgroundActive(active as boolean) if m.guideBackground.active <> active m.guideBackground.active = active end if end sub
function resolveServerUrl(manifestUrl as string) as string storedUrl = readSetting("server_url") if manifestUrl = "" if storedUrl <> "" then return storedUrl return "" end if if manifestUrl <> storedUrl writeSetting("server_url", manifestUrl) end if return manifestUrl end function
function readSetting(key as string) as string section = createObject("roRegistrySection", "AppSettings") if section.exists(key) then return section.read(key) return "" end function
sub writeSetting(key as string, value as string) section = createObject("roRegistrySection", "AppSettings") section.write(key, value) section.flush() end sub
sub onTvGuideMenuRequested() m.menuReturnTarget = "tvGuide" showSideMenu() end sub
sub onPlaylistGuideMenuRequested() m.menuReturnTarget = "playlistGuide" showSideMenu() end sub
sub onLiveGuideMenuRequested() m.menuReturnTarget = "liveTVGuide" showSideMenu() end sub
sub showSideMenu() m.sideMenu.visible = true m.sideMenu.focusRequested = true end sub
sub onSideMenuClosed() m.sideMenu.visible = false if m.menuReturnTarget = "playlistGuide" focusPlaylistGuide() else if m.menuReturnTarget = "liveTVGuide" focusLiveGuide() else focusTvGuide() end if end sub
sub onSettingsRequested() m.sideMenu.visible = false m.settingsView.serverUrl = m.serverUrl m.settingsView.visible = true m.settingsView.focusRequested = true end sub
sub onSettingsViewClosed() m.settingsView.visible = false showSideMenu() end sub
sub onViewRequested(event as object) requestedView = event.getData() if requestedView = "onDemand" loadOnDemandGuide() else if requestedView = "liveTV" loadLiveGuide() end if end sub
sub loadOnDemandGuide() m.sideMenu.visible = false m.settingsView.visible = false m.activeGuide = "onDemand" m.errorReturnTarget = "settings" m.catalogTask.control = "stop" showLoading("Loading On Demand...") m.catalogTask.uri = m.serverUrl m.catalogTask.control = "run" end sub
sub loadLiveGuide() m.sideMenu.visible = false m.settingsView.visible = false m.activeGuide = "liveTV" m.errorReturnTarget = "settings" uri = liveGuideUrl(m.serverUrl) if uri = "" showError("The Server URL must be configured before opening Live TV.") return end if showLoading("Loading Live TV guide...") m.liveGuideTask.uri = uri if not m.liveGuideTaskStarted m.liveGuideTaskStarted = true m.liveGuideTask.control = "run" else m.liveGuideReloadRequestId++ m.liveGuideTask.reloadRequestId = m.liveGuideReloadRequestId end if end sub
function liveGuideUrl(serverUrl as string) as string value = serverUrl.trim() if value = "" then return "" queryAt = instr(1, value, "?") if queryAt > 0 then value = value.left(queryAt - 1) while value.len() > 0 and value.right(1) = "/" value = value.left(value.len() - 1) end while if LCase(value.right(9)) = "/channels" then return value + "/guide" return value + "/channels/guide" end function
sub onSettingChanged(event as object) changed = event.getData() if changed <> invalid and changed.key = "server_url" m.serverUrl = changed.value m.tvGuide.content = invalid m.liveTVGuide.content = invalid end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" and m.liveTVGuide.visible and not m.videoComponent.visible if m.liveGuideBackDestination = "home" then return false if m.liveGuideBackDestination = "menu" onLiveGuideMenuRequested() else m.activeGuide = "onDemand" showGuide("onDemand") focusTvGuide() end if return true end if if key = "back" and m.tvGuide.visible and not m.videoComponent.visible return false end if return false end function
